mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% year-over-year, it indicates a potential monetary policy mismatch, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2% and SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) suggests strong labor market conditions, which can lead to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases and SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) indicates a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
